Complete documentation for all exported functions in `bgms`.

`bgm()` and `bgmCompare()` return S7 objects (classes `bgms` and `bgmCompare`). Standard methods like `print()`, `summary()`, and `coef()` work through S3 dispatch for compatibility with base R generics.

## Core Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`bgm()`](bgm.qmd) | Estimates the main effects and pairwise interactions of a network using a Bayesian framework. |
| [`bgmCompare()`](bgmCompare.qmd) | Estimates whether edge weights and category thresholds differ across networks of two different groups. |

## Prior Samplers

Draw from the model's priors before seeing data, for prior visualization
and simulation studies.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sample_ggm_prior()`](sample-ggm-prior.qmd) | Prior sampler for the GGM precision matrix (conditional, joint, or hierarchical specification). |
| [`sample_graph_prior()`](prior-samplers.qmd#sample_graph_prior) | Prior sampler for the edge-inclusion indicators and edge-prior hyperparameters. |
| [`sample_sbm_prior()`](prior-samplers.qmd#sample_sbm_prior) | Ancestral sampler for the stochastic block model hyperprior (allocations, pair probabilities). |

## Prior Constructors

Prior specification objects passed to `bgm()` and `bgmCompare()` via the
`interaction_prior`, `threshold_prior`, `means_prior`,
`precision_scale_prior`, `edge_prior`, and `difference_prior` arguments.

| Constructor | Family | Used for |
|-------------|--------|----------|
| [`cauchy_prior()`](priors.qmd#cauchy_prior) | Cauchy(0, scale) | Interactions (`bgmCompare()` default), thresholds, means |
| [`normal_prior()`](priors.qmd#normal_prior) | Normal(0, scale) | Interactions (`bgm()` default), thresholds, means |
| [`beta_prime_prior()`](priors.qmd#beta_prime_prior) | Beta-prime | Thresholds (default), interactions |
| [`gamma_prior()`](priors.qmd#gamma_prior) | Gamma(shape, rate or eta) | Precision-matrix diagonal |
| [`exponential_prior()`](priors.qmd#exponential_prior) | Exponential(rate or eta) | Precision-matrix diagonal (default) |
| [`bernoulli_prior()`](priors.qmd#bernoulli_prior) | Bernoulli | Edge / difference inclusion (default) |
| [`beta_bernoulli_prior()`](priors.qmd#beta_bernoulli_prior) | Beta-Bernoulli | Edge / difference inclusion |
| [`sbm_prior()`](priors.qmd#sbm_prior) | Stochastic Block Model | Edge / difference inclusion |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| [`print()`](methods.qmd#print) | Minimal console output for a fitted model |
| [`summary()`](methods.qmd#summary) | Summary statistics for posterior samples |
| [`coef()`](methods.qmd#coef) | Extract posterior means of model parameters |
| [`predict()`](methods.qmd#predict) | Predict new observations from a fitted model |
| [`simulate()`](methods.qmd#simulate) | Simulate datasets from the posterior distribution |
| [`simulate_mrf()`](methods.qmd#simulate_mrf) | Simulate observations from a Markov Random Field |

## Diagnostics

Post-fit checks on a model you have already estimated.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`prior_sensitivity_check()`](prior-sensitivity.qmd) | Recover each edge's inclusion Bayes factor curve across the slab scale and classify which verdicts depend on it. |
| [`summarize_zratio_gauge()`](prior-samplers.qmd#summarize_zratio_gauge) | Trust gauge for the hierarchical graph prior's fast normalizer approximation. |

## Extractor Functions

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`extract_arguments()`](extractors.qmd#extract_arguments) | Retrieve the arguments used when fitting a model |
| [`extract_main_effects()`](extractors.qmd#extract_main_effects) | Extract main-effect parameters: posterior means for `bgms` fits, posterior samples for `bgmCompare` fits |
| [`extract_pairwise_interactions()`](extractors.qmd#extract_pairwise_interactions) | Extract posterior samples of partial association parameters |
| [`extract_indicators()`](extractors.qmd#extract_indicators) | Extract posterior samples of edge or difference indicators |
| [`extract_posterior_inclusion_probabilities()`](extractors.qmd#extract_posterior_inclusion_probabilities) | Compute posterior inclusion probabilities, from the Rao-Blackwellized draws by default or from the raw indicator samples |
| [`extract_prior_inclusion_probabilities()`](extractors.qmd#extract_prior_inclusion_probabilities) | Compute prior inclusion probabilities, matched in shape to the posterior ones for Bayes factor computation |
| [`extract_inclusion_bf()`](extractors.qmd#extract_inclusion_bf) | Compute inclusion Bayes factors from the Rao-Blackwellized odds accumulators, on the Bayes factor scale by default or on the log scale with `log = TRUE`; finite even for saturated edges |
| [`extract_indicator_priors()`](extractors.qmd#extract_indicator_priors) | Retrieve the indicator prior specification (prior type and hyperparameters) |
| [`extract_group_params()`](extractors.qmd#extract_group_params) | Extract group-specific parameters from a `bgmCompare` fit |
| [`extract_sbm()`](extractors.qmd#extract_sbm) | Extract stochastic block model assignments and probabilities |
| [`extract_ess()`](extractors.qmd#extract_ess) | Compute effective sample sizes for model parameters; for indicators the Rao-Blackwellized ESS by default or the transition ESS with `estimator = "mixt"` |
| [`extract_rhat()`](extractors.qmd#extract_rhat) | Compute split-R-hat convergence diagnostics |
| [`extract_precision()`](extractors.qmd#extract_precision) | Extract posterior mean precision matrix (GGM / continuous block) |
| [`extract_partial_correlations()`](extractors.qmd#extract_partial_correlations) | Extract posterior mean partial correlation matrix |
| [`extract_log_odds()`](extractors.qmd#extract_log_odds) | Extract posterior mean log-odds matrix (OMRF / discrete block) |
